items.title: What Could Merck (MRK) Gain From Two Positive EU CHMP Opinions?
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) received positive opinions from the European Medicines Agency’s CHMP on new indications for ENFLONSIA and WELIREG. The CHMP backed ENFLONSIA for preventing RSV disease in young children, expanding Merck’s pediatric infectious disease reach in Europe. The committee also supported WELIREG combined with lenvatinib for adults with advanced renal cell carcinoma following prior therapy.
